Package index

High-Level Optimizer & Shiny Application

Primary entry points to run the query optimizer or launch the interactive Shiny dashboard.

optimize_search_queries()
Optimize semantically equivalent PubMed and Google Scholar queries for a BibTeX file
run_revlitquery_app()
Launch the interactive revlitquery Shiny application
revlitquery_app()
Create the revlitquery Shiny application object

BibTeX Parsing & PubMed Seed Enrichment

Parse BibTeX files and resolve seed articles against NCBI PubMed E-utilities.

parse_bibtex()
Parse a BibTeX file into a normalized tibble of seed papers
enrich_seeds()
Enrich BibTeX seed papers via PubMed
clean_latex_text()
Clean LaTeX markup and normalize whitespace in BibTeX field text
normalize_doi()
Normalize a DOI string to lowercase bare identifier
extract_pmid_value()
Extract a PubMed ID (PMID) from explicit fields or URL/note text
split_keywords()
Split BibTeX keywords string into cleaned lowercase character vector
title_jaccard()
Compute alphanumeric lowercase token Jaccard similarity between two titles
clean_title_for_query()
Clean title string for search queries (strip quotes/brackets/colons that break E-utilities)
title_sig_words()
First N significant words from a title for fallback matching

Candidate Term Extraction & Concept Blocks

Extract n-grams, synthesize prefix wildcards, probe PubMed frequencies, and group terms into PICO concept blocks.

extract_candidate_terms()
Extract and score candidate search terms from enriched seed papers
build_concept_blocks()
Build stem-disjoint, conditionally selective concept blocks from scored candidate terms
assign_term_family()
Classify a candidate search term into a coherent semantic PICO family
assign_term_families()
Vectorized wrapper for `assign_term_family()`
term_matches_text()
Check whether a candidate term matches each text in `texts` (case-insensitive, hyphen-flexible)
term_stems()
Simple token stemmer for lexical overlap detection across concept blocks
shares_stem()
Check whether two terms share any significant token stem
normalize_search_text()
Normalize text for n-gram extraction (preserves alphanumeric tokens like h5n1)
escape_regex()
Escape regex metacharacters in literal term
get_stopwords()
Stopword list (standard English + academic/methods filler)

Query Construction & Translation (PubMed & Google Scholar)

Canonical search query representation and translation to PubMed and Google Scholar (<= 256 chars).

make_query()
Construct a canonical query object
query_signature()
Deterministic canonical signature for deduplicating queries
to_pubmed_query()
Translate canonical query to PubMed E-utilities query string
to_google_scholar_query()
Translate canonical query to Google Scholar query string
pubmed_to_google_scholar_approx()
Convert a raw PubMed query string into an approximate Google Scholar query
gs_char_count()
Count characters in translated Google Scholar query
is_valid_gs_query()
Check Google Scholar <= 256 character constraint
pubmed_url()
Clickable PubMed search URL
google_scholar_url()
Clickable Google Scholar search URL

Pareto Frontier Optimization & Exclusion Mining

Two-stage Pareto frontier search, timeline-stratified exclusion concept discovery, and custom query benchmarking.

optimize_queries()
Run Stage 1 + Stage 2 Pareto query optimization
discover_exclusion_hints()
Discover concept-grouped candidate exclusion (NOT / -) terms from non-seed PubMed results
assign_exclusion_concept()
Classify a candidate exclusion term into a scientific exclusion concept
compute_pareto_frontier()
Compute non-dominated Pareto frontier indicator
generate_initial_candidates()
Generate diverse initial Stage 1 query candidates
estimate_local_query()
Estimate local seed coverage and rough PubMed hit count for a candidate query
evaluate_custom_query()
Evaluate a single user-supplied PubMed query against enriched seeds
add_custom_query_to_result()
Merge an evaluated custom query into an existing or minimal optimization result

NCBI E-utilities & Caching

Low-level PubMed API clients and disk caching helpers.

pubmed_esearch()
Query PubMed E-utilities esearch via HTTP POST
pubmed_efetch()
Fetch article metadata (title, abstract, MeSH, keywords) from PubMed efetch XML
pubmed_eval_query()
Evaluate a PubMed query: total hit count + which seed PMIDs are retrieved
cache_key()
Build deterministic cache key
cache_get()
Read cached RDS value if available
cache_set()
Write cached RDS value

Reporting & Shiny UI Helpers

Export reports, build interactive Plotly Pareto plots, and manage Shiny UI state.

write_optimization_report()
Write all optimization artifacts (CSVs, Markdown report, PNG plot) to `output_dir`
build_pareto_plotly()
Build interactive Plotly Pareto frontier chart
build_coverage_display_df()
Build display table for the Seed Coverage Matrix tab
recompute_recommendation()
Recompute recommended query on an existing Pareto frontier when sliders move
build_config_from_inputs()
Validate and assemble optimizer config list from Shiny sidebar inputs
parse_term_list()
Split a textarea string of terms on commas, semicolons, or newlines
parse_custom_blocks_yaml()
Parse optional custom concept blocks from YAML text
blocks_to_yaml()
Convert discovered concept blocks list into editable YAML text
